fieldData.course-description: Administrative professionals are an important part of ensuring events and business travel run seamlessly. This competency includes tasks involved in supporting the planning of an event, including scheduling, logistics management, communication, onsite support, and post-event follow-up. Success in this competency requires strong organizational skills, clear and effective communication and an eye for detail. These skills are essential for coordinating events and travel that meet objectives, run smoothly, and leave a positive impression on participants and stakeholders.
fieldData.name: Support Business Event Planning

fieldData.course-description: In Workplace Math, learners work with an Indigenous framework to apply critical thinking, creativity, and authentic learning opportunities to develop numeracy and essential skills for work, learning, and life.
fieldData.name: Workplace Math

fieldData.course-description: Essential Skills for Communication supports learners in identifying themselves within academic and workplace environments. Learners will explore various verbal and nonverbal communication methods through teachings of Elders and Knowledge Keepers, the practice of two-eyed seeing, and shared experiences as ambassadors in the community. Throughout the course, learners will showcase the knowledge, skills, and strategies they have honed to support their future learning and identity.
fieldData.name: Essential Skills for Communication

fieldData.course-description: Work Readiness Level 1 supports students' Indigenous ways of knowing, being, and doing by fostering two-eyed seeing in a workplace setting. Learners will create a work portfolio to showcase their learning throughout the course, enabling them to illustrate specific knowledge, skills, and strategies. Learning outcomes will be achieved through a variety of pathways with a focus on literacy, numeracy, and technology.

fieldData.course-description: Manage Data Using Excel is a crucial competency for handling, analyzing, and presenting data in a clear and organized manner. This involves creating spreadsheets using Microsoft Excel to manage and analyze data, as well as sharing relevant spreadsheet elements with stakeholders. The process requires strong analytical skills to interpret data correctly, effective problem-solving to address any issues or discrepancies, and precise attention to detail to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the data.‍
fieldData.name: Manage Data Using Excel

fieldData.course-description: Performing administrative tasks is central to the efficiency and organization of any office environment. The effective completion of administrative tasks such as organizing documents, managing emails and calendars, organizing meetings, and taking meeting minutes are just a few of the tasks that make administrative professionals invaluable in the office. This competency uses office technology such as SharePoint, Outlook, task management applications, and web conferencing applications. Effective administrative performance hinges on organizational skills, attention to detail, and time management, ensuring that all tasks are completed efficiently and accurately. By mastering this competency, administrative professionals contribute to the seamless functioning of an office.
fieldData.name: Perform Administrative Tasks in the Office

fieldData.course-description: For administrative professionals, the ability to produce high-quality business documents is a cornerstone of their role. This competency encompasses the ability to create a wide range of business documents using Microsoft Word and PowerPoint. With a focus on transversal skills, such as ergonomic awareness and attention to detail, as well as technical skills related to the formatting of documents, mastery of this competency ensures the professional standards expected of an administrative professional.
fieldData.name: Produce Business Documents
